correctness.rationale: For generic u, section vertices biject cube edges crossing the sign threshold. Fourier influence identity N=2^(d-1) sum_A |A| fhat(A)^2 and oddness imply N>=2^(d-1), with equality only a Boolean degree-one dictator: equivalently unique strict dominant |u_i|>sum_{j!=i}|u_j|. A Gaussian normal yields 2d P[G0>sum|Gj|]. Half-normal total-mass-simplex coordinates and chi-square times uniform-radius law give p_d=B_d E exp(-T). Independently rederived the Dirichlet factorial moments with direct k-tuples of indices for k=1..4,m=2..6; all four exact T-moment formulas match. Expanding E(T-1)=-2/m+O(m^-2), E(T-1)^2=3/m+O(m^-2), 3rd/4th moments O(m^-2), bounded fourth derivative proves relative 7/(2m) and e^-1. Dirichlet exponential construction plus bounded likelihood-ratio convergence and Gaussian tail conditioning give fixed-r exponential coordinate limits and m(1-U_I)->1. Finite tests are not substituted for full limiting proof.
